HD95_definition: 95th percentile of pooled bidirectional nearest 4-connected boundary Euclidean distances on 256x256 grid; units pixels, not mm
empty_policy: both empty: Dice/IoU=1, HD95=0; exactly one empty: Dice/IoU=0, HD95=infinity
averaging: unweighted per-image mean; no test sample is silently excluded
prediction_encoding: PNG pixel values 0 and 1; view using vmin=0,vmax=1
